runContext.patchObjective: Prevent Redis's embedded Lua default tostring implementation from exposing raw process memory addresses for non-scalar values (tables, functions, threads, userdata) by replacing pointer-derived representations with '<type>: <opaque>', while preserving scalar conversions, custom __tostring metamethods, and error propagation.

exclusions: Do not modify Lua debugger address output or unrelated pointer-reporting mechanisms; do not alter scalar conversions or custom __tostring; do not introduce per-object identifiers or random tokens; do not modify Lua VM execution controls or pattern matching.
